name: University of the Cumberlands
academic_ranking: Private Christian liberal arts university in Williamsburg, KY, offering Associate, Bachelor's, and graduate programs. Known for its 'One Price Promise' flat-rate tuition model. No specific admissions GPA/test-score academic profile was publicly listed on checked pages.
financial_aid: On-campus undergraduate tuition set under the 'One Price Promise' flat-rate model ($9,875/year tuition; ~$19,175 with housing/room & board of $9,300). Every student has a Cost of Attendance (COA) budget capping total aid. NAIA athletic scholarships available; contact the Student Financial Center for aid details. Source: ucumberlands.edu tuition page checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Softball program competes at the University of the Cumberlands athletics facilities in Williamsburg, KY. Specific softball facility details were not published on the pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NAIA women's softball program competing in the Mid-South Conference. Team X/Twitter account: @Patriots_UC_SB.
